close_reason: Fixed: inject() doc now notes duplicate injection is silently ignored
description: inject() uses HashSet::insert so calling inject(type, op) twice silently drops the second call — the fault still fires only once. The doc comment says 'next call to op' which doesn't warn against double-inject. A test that calls inject twice expecting two faults will silently observe only one. Suggested rewrite: add a sentence to the inject doc: 'Calling inject for the same (type_name, op) pair a second time has no effect — only one fault is queued at a time.'
title: inject() silently drops duplicate fault injection
